60s record cover layout with thick header

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic window of a person lying in a field of yellow flowers, surrounded by a wide, solid mustard-yellow frame that contains all typographic elements in the upper section.
coreVisualRelationships: The mustard border color matches the yellow of the flowers in the photograph.
The subject's dark hair and clothing provide a high-contrast anchor against the bright field.
Typography is justified to the top corners, creating a weighted header effect.
The photographic window occupies approximately 70% of the vertical space.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered in the photographic window, shown from the chest up, tilted diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top-left text, move across to the top-right metadata, then drop into the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid yellow border acts as significant negative space, isolating the central image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow frame with muted, naturalistic tones in the central photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using scale and alignment to differentiate primary title from secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century editorial weight and density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a person with a 1960s hairstyle lying in a field of yellow daffodils, captured on vintage warm-toned film. Place this image inside a square window centered within a solid mustard-yellow frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps geometric sans-serif text in terracotta orange. Align the main title to the top-left corner and secondary details to the top-right corner within the yellow border area.

verificationChecks: Is the border a solid mustard yellow?
Is the text all-caps and sans-serif?
Is the photograph centered with a clear margin?
Does the color of the text contrast subtly with the yellow background?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow of the border and flowers are harmonized.
Verify the text is strictly within the yellow border area.
Check that the subject's hair is dark to provide necessary contrast.
Confirm the overall layout is a perfect square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Color Frame + Inset Vintage Portrait + Corner-Justified Bold Sans-Serif Header
